savee.note: Official Savee hosted MCP server. Uses OAuth — on first connection the agent is prompted to authorize via browser; no API key to paste. Ten read tools (get_current_user, list_saves, get_save, list_feed, list_boards, list_board_saves, search, view_saves, list_comments, score_taste); create_board, update_board, save_items, remove_save_from_board and add_comment only when the matching write scope is granted; twelve Site Maker tools (get_site, edit_site, publish_site and others) with site access; get_usage (what's left of each limit) and send_feedback (a note to the Savee team) on every connection. Nothing deletes a save, a board or a comment.
